content:
Maria K: FYI I've pushed the initial RCA draft into the doc and tagged the impacted services. Can people review today? Summary in-thread: we had elevated 503s on the serving runtime between 03:12–03:46 UTC, causing ~12% error rate for hosted API for ~34 minutes. Root cause candidates: KV cache eviction thrash coincident with a rolling deploy and autoscaler cooldown behavior. Link: https://r.i/rca/1923456789

Jon P: Reading now. Quick q: do we have the exact deploy hash that coincided with the start? I pulled a deploy log: `deploy-2026-03-10-03:10:41` on prod-rt-3.

Ashwin R: Timeline looks broadly correct. Primary contributor was the cache-refresh routine at 03:11 which triggered high eviction rate -> cache misses -> backend pressure. Also the autoscaler removed nodes while pressure spiked, amplifying errors. I'll add metric correlations.

SRE Bot: Incident alert: paging resolved at 03:46 UTC. PagerDuty incident ID: PD-7812. Created incident channel #incident-1923456789 and auto-created timeline entries.

Lina S: I added a customer impact summary in the doc — affected tenants: 6 paid customers, degraded generation latency for ~17% of requests, and some long-running embedding jobs timed out. Drafted proposed customer comms.

Jon P: Left inline comments about the quantization workload that kicked off at 03:09 — that likely increased CPU pressure on pool A and reduced headroom during the rolling deploy.

Maria K: Thanks. Proposed action items (please confirm owners/due dates):
1) Revert `cache-refresh-optim` until we have unit + integration tests (owner: Ashwin R, due: EOD today).
2) Adjust autoscaler cooldown and add jitter to prevent simultaneous scale-down during transient spikes (owner: Jon P, due: 2 days).
3) Add synthetic churn test for KV cache to the regression suite (owner: Lina S, due: 1 week).
4) Create new alert on KV cache eviction rate and monotonic eviction spikes (owner: Platform SRE, due: 48h).
I put these into the action tracker as tasks once we confirm owners.

Product Ops: Need sign-off language for customer comms. Proposed short note: "We experienced intermittent service errors impacting text generation between 03:12 and 03:46 UTC on Mar 10, 2026. The issue has been mitigated and we have action items underway to reduce recurrence." OK?

Jon P: LGTM. Add a note that we'll consider credits for the 6 tenants pending Legal + Finance review.

Ashwin R: I'll draft the post-deploy test and keep the revert PR ready; adding timeline entries now:
```
03:09:00 UTC - quantization job started on pool A
03:10:41 UTC - rolling deploy `deploy-2026-03-10-03:10:41` began
03:11:50 UTC - cache-refresh routine executed; eviction rate spike observed
03:12:30 UTC - 503s first spike; incident pager fired
03:18:00 UTC - autoscaler removed 2 nodes from prod-rt-3
03:35:00 UTC - rollback of deploy initiated
03:46:00 UTC - error rate returned to baseline
```

Maria K: Can reviewers + Legal sign off by EOD? @Jon P @Ashwin R @Lina S :thumbsup:

SRE Bot: Note: RCA draft link updated, review requested from `platform@redwood.com`.

Jon P: :thumbsup: leaving final technical LGTM. One doc nit: avoid phrasing that sounds like assigning blame — keep it factual and focused on contributing factors.

Sarah L: I reviewed the customer comms; wording is acceptable. Do not promise credits publicly in the note; coordinate credit language with Finance. I'll approve the RCA draft once the customer-facing note and credit phrasing are finalized.

Maria K: Updated the doc with Legal's note. Proposed sign-off flow: Maria (incident lead) affirms the action items and that the timeline is accurate; Jon and Ashwin mark LGTM on technical items; Sarah (Legal) marks compliance; Product Ops signs off on customer messaging. Once all four are present, we'll transition the RCA to SIGNED.

Lina S: All done from my side — action items created in the tracker: CH-4527 (revert + tests), CH-4528 (autoscaler policy), CH-4529 (synthetic cache test).

Ashwin R: Revert PR merged at 04:02 UTC and I attached the test checklist to CH-4527. Marked owner.

Jon P: Autoscaler policy PR created: #8721, requesting review from eng-infra.

Maria K: Thank you all. Current RCA state: "awaiting sign-off". Please add a simple :thumbsup: in-thread and I'll flip the state to SIGNED once we have all approvers.

Product Ops: :thumbsup: We will not send customer notes until Legal confirms credit language and Finance approves any compensation.

Sarah L: :thumbsup: legal sign-off for the RCA doc. Coordinate final credit wording with Finance.

Maria K: Sign-off complete. Changing state -> SIGNED. Closing thread. :white_check_mark:
